project.description: Three-story rear addition to an existing three-flat. Zoning district RT-3.5. Standard Plan Review.
project.reviewer: Department of Buildings, first review cycle

comments.heading: Building
comments.text: Per 13-160, the handrail profile and return are not shown at the new stair. Show them on the stair section.

comments.heading: Zoning
comments.text: The addition exceeds the allowed height for the district. A variation from the Zoning Board of Appeals is required.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: Fireblocking in the attic where the addition meets the existing building is not addressed. Add it to the building section.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: The contractor's certificate of insurance is missing from the application.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: The sheet index lists A-103 under the wrong title. Correct the index.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: Note: any revision fee will be invoiced separately. No response is needed.

expected.why: Title 13 was replaced. A handrail is part of the means of egress design.
The next step is at the Zoning Board of Appeals.
Fireblocking in concealed spaces is fire-resistance design, despite the General heading.
Only the contractor has this certificate.
The letter says no response is needed.
